note: tokens: 0 wall, 1 open, 2 S, 3 G. log_z: natural log of the settled hidden output (null where z = 0). pointer_offset: (row, column) offset of the largest attention weight; [0, 0] = the cell itself. energy[t]: answer energy (entropy included) of sigmoid(u) after t descent steps, t = 0..descent_steps; energy_after_stop: the same for the steps after the stop.
